primary.title: This AI stock surges over 600% YTD; delivers bigger returns than Nvidia, SanDisk, Micron and Intel
primary.summary: In the AI boom, Netlist has seen significant growth, rising over 600% in 2026 after a deal with Samsung. Strong second-quarter earnings indicate improving financial health, yet the stock's volatility raises concerns about sustaining its gains over time.
